snippet.title: PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark OFFICIAL GAME TRAILER
snippet.description:
Enter a realm where light and time become powerful allies.

PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark combines multidimensional puzzles, ever-evolving worlds, and gameplay modes ranging from narrative adventures to competitive challenges. Bend reality, conquer the darkness.

Don’t wait, dive into the darkness now!
